Wand Specialization.sig: Increases your damage with Wands by #%.

Improved Channeling.t: No pushback on Arcane Missiles, {2}% chance on Arcane Blast and Wrath
Improved Channeling.sig: Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a #% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a #% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Arcane Resilience.sig: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to #% of your Intellect.

Arcane Subtlety.t: Targets resist {1} less, {2}% less Arcane threat
Arcane Subtlety.sig: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by # and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by #%.

Magic Absorption.sig: Increases all your resistances by # and causes all spells you fully resist to restore #% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than # time per sec.

Arcane Concentration.t: {1}% chance your next spell is free
Arcane Concentration.sig: Gives you a #% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by #%.

Missile Barrage.t: Spells can make your next Arcane Missiles {3}% faster
Missile Barrage.sig: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a #% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a #% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by #%, reduce the Mana cost by #%, and missiles fire every # sec.

Arcane Geometry.sig: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by # yards.

Arcane Impact.sig: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by #%.

Arcane Blast.t: Stacking Arcane nuke, each cast stronger and more expensive
Arcane Blast.sig: Blasts the target with energy, dealing # to # Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain #% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by #%. Effect stacks up to # times and lasts # sec from time of initial application.

Arcane Shielding.t: Mana Shield costs {1}% less mana, Mage Armor {2}% stronger
Arcane Shielding.sig: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by #% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by #%.

Improved Counterspell.sig: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for # sec.

Arcane Meditation.sig: Allows #% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Arcane Wrath.t: Arcane bolt that scales with your max mana
Arcane Wrath.sig: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing # to # Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to #% of your maximum Mana.

Presence of Mind.sig: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than # sec becomes an instant cast spell.

Arcane Mind.sig: Increases your Intellect by #% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by #%.

Arcane Instability.sig: Increases the damage done by your spells by #% and your critical strike chance by #%.

Arcane Power.t: +{2}% spell damage for {1} sec, spells cost {3}% more
Arcane Power.sig: For the next # sec, your spells deal #% more damage while costing #% more mana to cast.

Incineration.t: +{1}% crit on Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast and Scorch
Incineration.sig: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by #%.

Accelerant.t: Fireball, Frostfire Bolt and Arcane Wrath {1} sec faster
Accelerant.sig: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by # sec.

Ignite.t: Fire crits burn for {1}% more over {2} sec
Ignite.sig: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional #% of your spell's damage over # sec.

Flame Throwing.sig: Increases the range of your Fire spells by # yards.

Impact.t: {1}% chance Fire spells stun for {2} sec
Impact.sig: Gives your Fire spells a #% chance to stun the target for # sec.

Burning Soul.t: {1}% chance to ignore pushback, {2}% less Fire threat
Burning Soul.sig: Gives your Fire spells a #% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by #%.

Improved Flamestrike.sig: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by #%.

Pyroblast.t: Huge fireball with a burn over {4} sec
Pyroblast.sig: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes # to # Fire damage and an additional # Fire damage over # sec.

Improved Fire Blast.t: Fire Blast cooldown {1} sec shorter, {2} yards more range
Improved Fire Blast.sig: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by # sec and increases its range by # yards.

Improved Scorch.t: Scorch stacks +{2}% Fire damage taken, up to {4} times
Improved Scorch.sig: Your Scorch spell has a #% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by #% and lasts # sec, stacking up to # times.

Improved Fire Ward.sig: Causes your Fire Ward to have a #% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

Heating Up.t: Fire crits make your next Pyroblast {2}% faster, up to {3} times
Heating Up.sig: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within # sec by #%, stacking up to # times. Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage.

Master of Elements.t: Fire and Frost crits refund {1}% mana
Master of Elements.sig: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund #% of their base mana cost.

Critical Mass.sig: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by #%.

Blast Wave.t: Fire nova that dazes by {3}% for {4} sec
Blast Wave.sig: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for # to # Fire damage, and Dazing them for #% reduced movement speed for # sec.

Fire Power.t: +{1}% Fire damage per Fire effect, up to {2}%
Fire Power.sig: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by #% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of #%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.

Combustion.t: Each Fire hit adds +{1}% Fire crit until {2} crits
Combustion.sig: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by #%. This effect lasts until you have caused # non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

Frost Warding.t: Frost and Ice Armor {1}% stronger, Frost Ward can negate spells
Frost Warding.sig: Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by #%, gives your Frost Ward a #% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by #%.

Improved Frostbolt.sig: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by # sec.

Precision.sig: Improves your chance to hit with all spells by #%.

Ice Shards.sig: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by #%.

Frostbite.sig: Gives your Chill effects a #% chance to Freeze the target for # sec.

Improved Frost Nova.sig: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by # sec.

Permafrost.t: Chills last {1}% longer and slow {2}% more
Permafrost.sig: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by #% and reduces the target's speed by an additional #%.

Frost Channeling.sig: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by #% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by #%.

Improved Blizzard.sig: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by #% for # sec.

Ice Lance.t: Instant frost hit, {3}% more against frozen targets
Ice Lance.sig: Deals # to # Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals #% increased damage to Frozen targets.

Arctic Reach.sig: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by #%.

Ice Block.sig: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for # sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

Shatter.sig: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by #%.

Improved Cone of Cold.sig: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by #%.

Cold Snap.sig: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

Fingers of Frost.t: {1}% chance your next {2} spells treat the target as frozen
Fingers of Frost.sig: Gives your Chill effects a #% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next # spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts # sec.

Winter's Chill.t: Frostbolt and empowered Ice Lance make Cone of Cold {2}% stronger
Winter's Chill.sig: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a #% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by #% and it gains an additional #% of your spell damage, stacking up to # times.

Ice Barrier.t: Absorb shield, +{2}% Frost damage while it lasts
Ice Barrier.sig: Shield yourself, absorbing # damage and increasing your Frost damage by #% for # min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional #% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.
